title: VDI Authentication Troubleshooting Guide
content: Synthetic VDI support guide for Example Manufacturing. For VDI login failure following a corporate AD password change: IT Support checks AD account lock status without modifying the account. Ask the user to save any work they can access, then fully sign out of the existing VDI session. Ask the user to reauthenticate using the updated password. If the issue persists, IT Support verifies credential synchronization status without changing account settings. Escalate unresolved cases to Identity Support. This guide does not authorize account unlocking, credential disclosure, privilege changes, or security control bypasses.
